purpose: Measure the economic value and cost of waiting for confirmation on the same preregistered Stage A origins.
eligibility: Stage A gates must pass both frozen three-year periods; Stage A statistical association is not economic qualification.
origins: Every saved Stage A origin, all 56212, including no-control or censored event observations. One shared 2020-2025 origin ledger, never select origins from later confirmations.

signal_rules.reversal_close_next_open: First bar j in t+1..t+11 with side*(close-open)>0 and lower3<close<upper3.
signal_rules.breakout_close_next_open: After the first reversal candle j, first later candle k<=t+11 whose close is strictly above j high for buy or below j low for sell.
signal_rules.cancellation: Before each later confirmation/breakout check, gap from prior bar!=300sec cancels, then strict breach of origin low for buy/high for sell cancels. Cancellation wins over confirmation/breakout on same candle. Equal extreme does not cancel. After reversal signal is emitted, that arm executes next open; later cancellation only affects breakout arm. No opposite-touch or context/wick filters.
signal_rules.target: SMA20 at each arm's closed signal rounded to native tick with floor(price/tick+0.5)*tick. Fixed throughout position; targets may differ because signal times differ.
signal_rules.entry: Next contiguous M5 open, inside the current three-year book. Actual target distance must be positive and >=3pips (1e-9pip tolerance). No chase/retry after failed room/gap. Signal at final book bar remains pending and unfilled. Signals beyond period end remain no-entry origins.

execution: Reuse scripts/research_bb3_jev_engine.py simulate with rr1, entry_delay1, min_center_pips3, allowed=None. One position per symbol per arm; occupied signals ignored. Process next open entry, open-gap exits, then SL-first intrabar exits, then new closed-bar signals. SL=2*entry-target unrounded mirror, entire position exits at TP or SL, RR1 before costs. No time stop. Period-end unrealized marked at final close separately, not counted as closed trade or PF.
period_semantics: Each three-year book starts flat, origin sequence is shared without reset. Signals are filtered by origin's book as well as signal timing; an origin from2022 never enters the2023 book. No carry of positions across2023. The six-year display sums these two separate books and is not a continuous six-year simulation.
cost_description: Fixed hypothetical round-trip subtraction once per closed or currently open trade; no historical GMO spread/slippage series or swaps. Pips/1R scores, no account currency sizing.
episode_ledger: Every origin has status and zero gross/net R if no actual entry; occupied/gap/room/expired/extreme/gapcancel/period reasons retained. Closed R and open marked R separate; episode netR=closed+open. Open grossR adds back cost/risk once, just as closed grossR. Mean netR per origin includes all zeros. Conditional trade results also reported.
statistics: For each period and comparison use all matched origin IDs, paired difference of grossR and netR at1pip; event-weighted mean and joint origin-month cluster percentile95%CI,10000 draws,seed20261003. Origin month assigned across all currencies. Whole-month blocks do not fully capture dependence of positions held across months; max holding and open counts reported. No causal claim and no untouched holdout claim.
waiting_beneficial_screen: A given preregistered comparison passes only if grossR difference CI lower>0 and netR difference CI lower>0 in both periods. Evaluate each comparison, no posthoc promotion of another endpoint.
economic_next_research_screen: Each arm separately must have >=100 closed trades, closed PF_R>=1.2, net+openR>0, stress1.2pip net+openR>0 and >=4 of7 symbols net+openR>0 in each period. All arms reported, no winner selection by later P/L. This screen does not approve live trading or Pine deployment.
data_exposure: All years previously viewed; descriptive comparison. Prior-control association bias and M5/missing-M1/source-clock limitations from Stage A persist. Arm comparisons change waiting plus signal-time target, so are policy differences, not pure causal effects of delay.
frozen_at: 2026-10-03 JST; main approved and independent validator/quality prereview passed before Stage B P/L
